prompt_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent game inventory icon. Subject: {subject}. Match a simple fantasy pawn game: thick very dark charcoal rounded outline, flat muted colors, at most two shading tones, no fine texture, large clear silhouette readable at 32 pixels. One isolated item centered in square canvas with 10 percent clear padding. Genuine transparent background, no ground shadow, no lettering, no grid, no border. This is a finished usable sprite, not a mockup.
